- **Coverage ID:** `cov-ss34-inverting-rail-application`
- **Status:** COVERED

**Reason:** D3's -13.5V inverting-rail reverse-voltage stress (Vin + |Vout| = 28.5V) leaves an 11.5V margin against the 40V VRRM rating, a smaller but still positive margin than D1/D2's non-inverting Vin-only stress (15V, 25V margin).
